question: India's border with which country runs 4,096.70 km (2,545.57 mi)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bangladesh.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India shares a border of **1,751 km with Nepal,** which is the** longest international border** that India shares with any of its neighbors.
 
• India shares a border of** 3,323 km with Pakistan,** which is the **second-longest **international border that India shares with any of its neighbors.
 
• India shares a border of **4,096 km with Bangladesh,** which is the **third-longest international border **that India shares with any of its neighbors.
 
• India shares a border of **3,488 km with China,** which is the **fourth-longest international border **that India shares with any of its neighbors. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• India shares land borders with** seven** countries - Pakistan, China, Nepal, Bhutan, Bangladesh, Myanmar, and Afghanistan.
 
• The** India-Nepal border** is open and people from both countries can cross the border **without a visa**. 
 
 
• This is because of the **Indo-Nepal Friendship Treaty of 1950.**
 
 
 
• The** India-Pakistan border **is one of the most **heavily guarded borders** in the world.
 
 
• It is also known as the **"Line of Control" or "LoC"**.
 
 
 
• The **India-Bangladesh border** is known as the **"International Border" **as it separates two sovereign nations.
 
 
• The border is also referred to as the **"East Pakistan Border"** as it was the border between India and East Pakistan before Bangladesh gained independence in 1971.
 
 
 
• The** India-China border **is also known as the "**Line of Actual Control" or "LAC"**.
 
 
• The border has been a **source of tension** between the two countries and has led to several military standoffs in the past.
